proposals.title: force_flush() is an unconditional no-op contradicting the durability contract

current_state.spec: FR-05: force_flush() ensures all mutations are durable on disk.
current_state.code: force_flush() logged and returned Ok(()) in all configs; never called flush_to_disk/trigger_flush.

proposals.proposed_resolution: Draft a code fix: add a type-erased FlushTrigger installed by the wiring layer via attach_flush_trigger; force_flush() invokes it and blocks, mapping errors to StorageError; no-op only when no trigger is installed.
proposals.verification: cargo build -p extended-metadata-store (default) clean + doc-test passes (via throwaway workspace wiring, since reverted). Unit tests under --features testing blocked by ALIGN-001 (deferred) and the pre-existing read_write_stats mock defect.
proposals.outcome: Fix drafted on branch. 001 spec FR-05 status/Known Gaps updated to describe the trigger mechanism and the deferred verification.
